newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Corp Geo started as attractive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Corp Geo started as attractive.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns said on Tuesday it had initiated coverage of Mexican construction firm Corporacion Geo with an attractive rating.

-- Analysts Sobani Warner and Daniel Altman said Geo, Mexico's largest low-income home-builder, is well positioned to compete because of its technologically advanced home design, focus on marketing and solid capital structure.

-- On the positive side, analysts mentioned the Mexican government's commitment to low-income housing, a shortage of some 6 million low-income homes, and the company's backlog of mortgage commitments.

-- As risks, the analysts pointed to the company's need for about $200 million in new working capital, its dependence on subsidized financing schemes and government regulation, and pressure on prices because of weak worker wages.
-- "Bottom line earnings momentum is forecast to come principally from strong top-line growth and margin expansion," the analysts said.
